title: Lawn parties, weekend jobs and the bands at Milneburg
summary: Bands travelled for Friday-Saturday lawn parties and played Sunday at Milneburg pavilions side by side.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: What kind of jobs did y'all play in those days with those different bands?

Well lawn parties was the most. They was going big, middle of the week or any time. And like maybe they called Buddy Petit to go to Bugaloosa Friday and Saturday. They called me to go to Gurpoor, Biloxi Friday and Saturday. They called Rene to go up here in maybe Macomb City or Bad Nourish. But that's how the band made their money. Every band like Saturday and Friday to go off somewhere. Sunday they had to be back here to play these economy halls and advertising and things all like that. Now all day Sunday the band that is not on the streets is out at that lake. The band that wasn't on the street was out on that lake, playing like the devil. I remember sometimes they used to have seven, eight bands out there. And Dick I don't mean far apart. This man got this pavilion here. You got one right over there. And tell you how close together. If they're playing, we have to stay still, people would have to dance by their music. And we play, they dance by our music. That's how close we were together. They had them things built out in the water, you know.
You remember any of the different guys that was playing?
Oh, you mean out on them things?
Well, I'm telling you now, Rene, myself, Buddy Petit be somewhere, Chris Kelly be somewhere. And different bands, you know like that.
